title: EduMirror: Modeling Educational Social Dynamics with Value-driven Multi-agent Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a school setting with agents to observe the emergence of in-group favoritism, exclusion, and out-group prejudice, and evaluating the effects of contact-based regulation interventions on agent interactions.

Applying a unified style normalization process to agent behaviors generated by multiple different base LLMs prior to evaluation, ensuring the LLM-based rater assesses substantive behavioral differences rather than favoring specific superficial language styles.
